blocks.text: Jensen Huang has been reinstated by the NVIDA board as CEO. This comes after Huang was reportedly involved in an extramarital affair that led to him allegedly leaking information to a Chinese spy. He was also allegedly involved in another affair with an NVIDIA employee.

blocks.caption: Nvidia president and CEO Jensen Huang speaks during the Annual GPU Technology conference in Taipei, Taiwan, 30 May 2018. Huang discussed Advance computing, Artificial intelligence and new GPU units during the conference.  EPA/RITCHIE B. TONGO

blocks.text: The board had reinstated Huang under some pressure by President Donald Trump. Trump and Huang share a close relationship with the president openly consulting Huang on the future of AI.
The extramarital affair with a Chinese spy was allegedly used as leverage from China to acquire banned NVIDIA GPU’s which are crucial to furthering the AI race.
